crossRefs.note: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
“Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them…
Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
If anyone teaches a different doctrine, and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to…
For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for…
and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let…
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

translations.web: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
translations.bsb: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
